description: Joint Research Centre: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Corrugated board boxes; technology mix; production mix, at plant; 16,6; Continuous filament glass fibre (dry chopped strands); The main end-us; European Broadband user experience; Broadband – households having access to the internet. Formats seen: ZIP, SHP, CSV, JSON, ODS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://eplca.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ELCD3/templates/default/html/datasetLicense.html), European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
